name: Foundation Runtime and Persistence
purpose: Fix the authoritative local persistence, migration, transaction-duration, typed-document, durable-job, and publication boundaries that every domain implementation depends on.

decisions.decision: SQLite is the single authoritative Beta 1.0 operational datastore and all authoritative connections use one SOMA-owned verified connection factory.

Application write transactions are intentionally short: external/file parsing, expensive computation and operator review happen outside the transaction, followed by fresh state revalidation and bounded commit.
Migration changes and ledger evidence publish atomically under one exclusive migrator; accepted migration bytes and identity are immutable and non-disposable data is corrected forward only.
Migration/status inspection is a pure observational mode and must not initialize, mutate, repair, checkpoint, migrate, or create defaults.
Restart-relevant job/proposal/checkpoint state is durable and explicit rather than browser/process-memory-only.
JSON persistence is allowed only through named/versioned bounded contracts; normalized relational domain facts do not migrate into generic JSON blobs.
Caches/projections/runtime registries/diagnostics are non-authoritative; any cache/projection must be rebuildable from accepted authority.
HLD-14 owns audit/event/history semantics while HLD-02 owns their common relational/transactional persistence mechanics.

unresolved_here_by_design: exact SQLite driver/wrapper and connection-factory API
journal/synchronous/busy-timeout configuration and encryption-compatible SQLite settings
exact migration file/manifest serialization and digest representation
exact durable job table/schema and lease/checkpoint mechanics
exact database backup/restore encryption and publication mechanics delegated to HLD-13/LLD-12
